gloss: to read aloud, to read out

definitions.gloss: to read aloud, to read out
definitions.explanation: To read text out loud so that others can hear, often in a formal or official context.
To formally announce or recite something, such as names or results.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{名簿|めいぼ}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The teacher read out the roll call.

examples.japanese: {受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}が{読|よ}み{上|あ}げられた。
examples.english: The names of the award winners were announced.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}の{内容|ないよう}を{声|こえ}に{出|だ}して{読|よ}み{上|あ}げてください。
examples.english: Please read the contents of the contract out loud.

notes:
{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to read aloud or announce.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {読|よ}む (to read) + {上|あ}げる (to raise, to complete) → to read by raising one's voice

ASPECT (ている):
{読|よ}み{上|あ}げている indicates an ongoing action of reading aloud.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {名前|なまえ}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる (read out names)
- {文章|ぶんしょう}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる (read a text aloud)
- {声|こえ}に{出|だ}して{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる (read out loud)

DIGITAL CONTEXT:
- {読|よ}み{上|あ}げ{機能|きのう}: text-to-speech function
- {音声|おんせい}{読|よ}み{上|あ}げ: audio reading/text-to-speech

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {声|こえ}に{出|だ}して{読|よ}む: to read out loud (more casual)
- {読|よ}み{上|あ}げる is more formal, often used in official announcements

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
